Subject: Quick recap + proposed next step (60–90m technical deep-dive)

Hi Jessica / Carlos —

Thanks again for the chat today — good overview of your use cases (real-time inference for dashboarding, per-tenant isolation, and a 99th percentile latency target under 200ms). I wanted to summarize our notes and propose a focused next step so we keep momentum.

Summary (very high level):
- Workload: mixed batch + low-latency API calls from dashboards
- Current infra: k8s on AWS with GPU VMs for training; no serving layer yet
- Key constraints: PII data residency in us-east-1, throughput ~200 req/s peak, cost sensitivity for embeddings

Proposed next step: schedule a technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML serving and infra engineers to:
1) validate throughput & latency assumptions
2) run through prefix/KV cache recommendations and batching impact
3) talk deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private VPC) and compliance controls
4) align on a mutual action plan and success criteria

Availability: I can offer these slots (all US PT):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 21, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Apr 22, 09:00–10:30

If none work, please send a few windows that do. We’ll include our ML infra leads and a solution architect — planning to cover specific latency/cost tradeoffs and a short demo of the serving runtime.

I attached a 1-page preliminary agenda to help prep.

Best,
Mina Haddad

1) Perf baseline: bring any benchmark slides or perf numbers for sequence lengths between 128–1024 tokens. Focus on tail latency (95/99th) and a couple of representative batch sizes.
2) KV cache/prefix caching: prepare 2 slides showing expected token-cost delta with and without caching on their workload distribution.
3) Deployment options: short bullets comparing Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC for cost, isolation, and compliance (we likely recommend Private or Dedicated given residency ask).
4) Security brief: if you can draft 2–3 lines on audit logs and KMS integration, we can have that ready if Sara asks.

I assigned high-level ownership: Aditya (perf + caching), Camila (demo + deployment options). If you need product/security backup ping me — we can invite one of our security engineers if Sara confirms.
